The '''Blackscale "Hall Sweeper" carbine''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] weapon made specifically for use in the confined corridors of the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]], by members of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Elements of real-world weapons have been incorporated into this design: the buttstock is taken from the German [[Wikipedia:FG-42|FG-42 (Model I)]] rifle, while the pistol grips appear to be taken from the [[Wikipedia:MG-42|MG-42]] machine gun.
